title: Ban pact for mob
description: You can craft a pact to ban mobs (until warden, ender dragon, wither and elder guardian). You can also craft a pact to unban mobs.
body:
You can craft a ban pact and an unban pact for mobs. Mobs who are banned can't spawn. They can be unban with the unban pact. To craft ban pact : Enchanted golden apple, nether star, totem of undying, piglin head, echo shard, heart of the sea, netherite pickaxe, heavy core and elytra.
To craft unban hammer, it's the same craft but there is not echo shard but amethyst shard. 

Mod inspired of the Chill smp of Tom LWSM.
